hints.title: Connected Component Equivalence
hints.text: Friendship relationships form connected components where indirect friends share common roots.

hints.title: Pre-Merge Restriction Testing
hints.text: Before combining two components, verify that no restricted pair belongs to the two candidate groups.

hints.title: Disjoint Set Update
hints.text: If all restriction constraints hold, merge the two components and accept the friendship request.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(R * M * alpha(N)) checking restrictions per request
complexity.notes: A request merges components only if no restricted pair ends up in the same merged component.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph traversal check per request takes O(M * (V + E)) which is significantly slower than DSU.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: DSU path compression achieves near-constant check and union operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should test whether find(x) and find(y) match the roots of u and v.
